notes: spin.co.in was not checked directly (not required once the live storefront was confirmed); madewithspin.com is the live Shopify storefront and was used throughout. robots.txt (https://www.madewithspin.com/robots.txt) only disallows /admin and /cgi-bin, no Claude-specific block, so HTTP-first (curl) access was used successfully for the whole investigation (Tier 1, no Playwright/Chrome needed). Enumerated the full site taxonomy via /collections.json (limit=250, paginated to page=4; only page 1 returned data, confirming 236 total collections, no truncation). SPIN is primarily a furniture/home-accessories brand (sofas, bar carts, storage, tableware) rather than a decor-first retailer, and its collection taxonomy reflects that: of 236 collections, only 5 title/handle-matched any holiday/festival keyword (christmas, xmas, gift, celebrate, diwali, holi, rakhi/raksha, new-year, valentine, easter, thanksgiving, eid, mother/father's day, navratri, lohri, ganesh, pongal, onam, ramadan). Each candidate was content-verified via /collections/<handle>/products.json rather than trusting collections.json's products_count field (confirmed inflated again here: 'celebrate-with-spin' listed as 234 in collections.json but products.json enumerates only 107 actual products; 'gifting' listed as 22 vs 16 actual; 'curated-gift' listed as 4 vs 0 actual). RESULT - GENUINE: 'christmas-trees' (5 products, all X-mas trees: Elf/Joy/Pine/Cone/Aura) and 'x-mas-ornaments' (11 products: snowflake ornaments, tealight holder, Uno ornaments, Aura ornament set, PLUS all 5 of the christmas-trees products re-listed). Confirmed via product-ID diff that christmas-trees' 5 IDs are a strict subset of x-mas-ornaments' 11 IDs (6 ornament-only products are unique to x-mas-ornaments). Both are reported as separate rows because the site itself presents them as two distinct browsable collection pages, but the overlap is flagged on both rows so the merge step does not double-count the 5 shared products as 16 unique items. EXCLUDED as false positives after content sampling: 'Celebrate With SPIN' (celebrate-with-spin, 107 actual products) - sampled 15 products, all generic catalog items (trays, storage boxes, bar cabinets, armchairs, barstools) with zero occasion-specific titles/tags/descriptions; this is a generic 'gifting/celebration' marketing collection reused across the whole catalog, classic false-positive pattern. 'Gift With SPIN' (gifting, 16 actual products) - sampled all 16, entirely generic desk organisers/storage boxes/trays, no occasion character. 'Curated Gift' (curated-gift) - products.json returned 0 products (empty despite collections.json claiming 4); dead/decommissioned collection. NOT FOUND despite targeted checks: Diwali, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, New Year, Valentine's Day, Easter, Thanksgiving, Eid, Mother's/Father's Day, Navratri, Lohri, Pongal, Onam - none exist as collections in the full 236-collection enumeration, and a slug-probe of 18 plausible handles (diwali, diwali-decor, diwali-gifts, festive, new-year, holi, raksha-bandhan, rakhi, valentines-day, mothers-day, fathers-day, easter, thanksgiving, eid, etc.) plus a nonsense control slug (nonsense-xyz-test-12345) all returned clean 404s, confirming Shopify returns real 404s here (no soft-404/catch-all masking) and none of these pages exist even unlinked. Also checked the on-site search (/search?q=...&view=json) for festival terms as a taxonomy-independent check: this surfaced exactly 2 genuinely Diwali-relevant products - 'Nova Glass Diya - Set of 2' (product description explicitly: 'a modern take on the traditional diya... A design-forward gift for the festive season') and 'Astro Brass Diya' - but these are ORPHAN products with empty tags/product_type and are not members of any collection (not present in any of the 236 collections.json entries); since the site's own taxonomy has no Diwali category/collection page to link to, no Diwali row is reported per the task's category-taxonomy scope, but this is noted here in case a future pass wants to track loose occasion-relevant SKUs separately. Also verified the 'New' collection (handle 'new', 59 products) is generic new-arrivals (Level Monitor stand, desk trays, vases, etc.), not New Year - correctly excluded. Also checked 'santa', 'snowman', 'wreath', 'ornament', 'tinsel' search terms for any additional Christmas items beyond the 11 in x-mas-ornaments; no further genuine matches (fuzzy search returned unrelated color-variant titles like 'Forest Green', 'Brick Red' etc. which are just Shopify option values, not distinct Christmas products).

rows.evidence: products.json for /collections/x-mas-ornaments enumerates 11 products: Home Tealight Holder (Set of 2), Snowflake X-mas Ornament (L), Snowflake X-mas Ornament (S), Uno X-mas Ornament (Round), Uno X-mas Ornament (Square), Aura X-mas Ornament (Set of 3), Aura X-mas Tree (Set of 3), Pine X-mas tree (Set of 3), Cone X-mas tree (Set of 2), Elf X-mas tree (Set of 2), Joy X-mas tree (Set of 2). All titles are explicitly Christmas-themed (X-mas/ornament/tree naming), 100% occasion-specific, none generic catalog items.
